verdicts.reason: Both use the same left-to-right leaderboard structure: logo panel, a 3-line headline, a body column and the CTA. Both keep far too much copy for 90px tall. The body paragraph, the 'Ships late June' line and the 'Limited Summer Release' kicker are tiny and hard to read. The 'Reserve a Case' button is smaller than the headline and is cramped against the right edge. The body column is also jammed against the headline. B is marginally better because its logo is larger and holds more brand presence in the white panel. In A the logo is undersized and sits in excess white space.
